Hi, everyone. You have probably heard that the city is holding
its first-ever craft fair, and it will happen near our candle shop
this summer. I believe we will have much more business
than usual at our store, selling handmade candles and
candleholders. More customers means other changes will
come. As you know, we've operated as a cash-only business,
but credit card payments are much quicker for everyone
So, to help with the added business, credit card readers will
be installed at each of our cash registers next week. ® The
system may seem complicated, ® but just so you know, there
will be training for all staff
What is the speaker explaining?
A) How to open a craft store
B) How to make a display for a trade show
C) How to prepare for extra business
D) How to create new advertising
B)

be introduced?

B) To speed up customer service

staff?
A) To provide information about new products

context.transcript_translation: 大家好。你们可能听说市要在今年夏天在我们蜡烛店附近举办首届手工艺品交易会。我相信我们的店里会比平时生意兴隆，销售手工蜡烛和烛台。更多的顾客意味着其他变化也会到来。如您所知，我们一直以现金交易为生，但信用卡支付对每个人来说都快得多。因此，为了应对增加的业务量，下周将在我们每个收银机处安装刷卡器。系统可能看起来很复杂，但只是让你们知道，所有员工都会接受培训的。
